================================================================================
Reserved immediate keyword remains valid alongside a word alternative
================================================================================
.match!
---
(program (keyword_member))

================================================================================
Word alternative accepts an unreserved word
================================================================================
.other?
---
(program (word_member (word)))

================================================================================
Word alternative allows whitespace before an unreserved word
================================================================================
. other?
---
(program (word_member (word)))

================================================================================
Reserved keyword prefix remains a valid word
================================================================================
.matcher?
---
(program (word_member (word)))

================================================================================
Word alternative must not allow whitespace before a reserved immediate keyword
:error
================================================================================
. match!
---
(ERROR)

================================================================================
Word alternative must not allow a newline before a reserved immediate keyword
:error
================================================================================
.
match!
---
(ERROR)

================================================================================
Reserved spelling cannot be accepted through the word alternative
:error
================================================================================
.match?
---
(ERROR)

================================================================================
Whitespace does not allow the word alternative to bypass reservation
:error
================================================================================
. match?
---
(ERROR)

================================================================================
Reserved immediate token must not steal an adjacent ordinary keyword
================================================================================
(value)match!
---
(program (ordinary_keyword (word)))

================================================================================
Ordinary keyword remains valid after whitespace
================================================================================
(value) match!
---
(program (ordinary_keyword (word)))

================================================================================
Ordinary keyword remains valid after a newline
================================================================================
(value)
match!
---
(program (ordinary_keyword (word)))

================================================================================
Ordinary word alternative remains valid alongside the ordinary keyword
================================================================================
(value)other?
---
(program (ordinary_word (word) (word)))

================================================================================
Ordinary word alternative does not bypass keyword reservation
:error
================================================================================
(value)match?
---
(ERROR (word))
